services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: We are Licensed by the Maryland Department of Natural Resources as a Chesapeake Bay Fishing Guide (Charter Captain), which means we can take you out fishing as a specific charter ($785). We can also add a fishing to one of our usual cruises while at anchor (call or email to request - $45 per rod). We provide rods, reels and fishing tackle and bait. Our half-day fishing cruise for Families and Friends is more oriented to fun rather than the high-intensity 'Catch-every-fish-in-the-Chesapeake' charters that leave at 4 am crammed to the gunnels with hundreds of wonderful people hunting Jaws. services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Join us for our daily sunset cruises: 6:00 - 8:30 pm ($675). We also have monthly Full Moon Rising - Sunset charters too. Scroll down to see our boats and prices. Generally, Irie Vibes cruises the South River and tributaries, and anchors for Watersport fun (if you like). Therapy sails down the South River to the Chesapeake Bay and Thomas Point Lighthouse, then cruises back up the South River into the Sunset - yes, it's a gorgeous cruise!. Capacity: 6 guests per boat; 12 guest on our 2 Boat Raft-up Parties (Call to Book).
